channel.description: Recent content in Python on Coding With Matt

item.title: Phase 5: Drawing Graphics — Shapes, Scenes, and Animation
item.description: Connect counts to coordinates, place neighboring characters, and turn a scene function into a finite animation.

item.title: PokePlot, Lesson 1: Ask the Pokédex
item.description: Read the API docs, turn JSON into Python data, and download three Pokémon pictures. Then complete a few small functions to collect your team.

item.title: Phase 4: The Frame Buffer — Draw First, Show Second
item.description: Connect raw pixel bytes to drawing methods, keep prepared and displayed images separate, and choose when to send a complete frame.

item.title: NumPy: Think in Arrays
item.description: Organize data in arrays, transform many values at once, and use masks and axes to answer questions about the data.

item.title: Phase 3: Memory Organization — Pages, Bytes, and Coordinates
item.description: Explore a tiny Lite-Brite, practice grid-to-list addresses, and trace a pixel into the SSD1306’s page-organized bytes.

item.title: Phase 2: Pictures as Data — Binary, Hex, and Bit Masks
item.description: Build and edit a picture’s smallest pieces: bits and bytes. Explore binary and hex in an interactive byte-building game.

item.title: Phase 1: Meet the OLED — Pixels, Coordinates, and show()
item.description: Put your own message on an OLED, explore a magnified pixel grid, and learn the roles of the display object, I2C connection, driver, and show().

item.title: Brightening and Averaging Images with NumPy
item.description: A question-and-answer introduction to safe image arithmetic, vectorization, clipping, stacking, axes, and image averages with NumPy.

item.title: Intro to ML With Python
item.description: Get started with Python and Machine Learning with a fantastic, free, online coures.

item.title: Project 1: The Pico OLED Display
item.description: The first Pico project: find the prerequisites, supplies, wiring, and lesson roadmap for learning an OLED from its first pixels to a small driver.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Pico WH
item.description: Explore what a microcontroller can do, get to know the Pico WH and its pins, and find a growing collection of projects—beginning with an OLED display.
